caller_context.arc_paper_tool_notes: Bounded ARC paper evidence is available only through resolver-supplied typed operation requests and responses. Treat returned evidence as read-only. Do not invoke ARC CLIs, shell commands, or MCP tools from the worker. Use typed resolver operations for cached/local checks in the source domain, target domain, and their intersection; use internet search only for uncached, recent, or non-arXiv public evidence. Record each check with its operation or query and short result.
